messages:
Maya Singh (Recruiter): FYI inbound candidate Maria Alvarez (senior infra) traveling internationally. Arrival 2027-02-16 22:10 local. Interview loop next day 09:30-15:00. She needs an official invitation letter for her visa appointment, one night hotel due to late arrival, local SIM or eSIM, kosher meal, and a quiet spot for a 20m phone call at 14:00. Can we confirm?
Alex Gu: I'll take the invitation letter content. Maya, can you DM Maria a list of what needs to be on it (dates, address, contact)? We need full name as on passport.
Maya Singh (Recruiter): Already asked Maria; confirmed passport name is "María Elena Alvarez" and passport number included privately. I'll send details to Alex.
Jonah (IT): IT: we can provision a temporary eSIM voucher or a physical SIM. Which does she prefer? eSIM QR works well for iPhone. We also have a noise-cancelling headset (asset H-55) for the quiet call.
Maria Alvarez: eSIM would be great if possible 4f6. Also can I get an invoice-style letter for the consulate showing purpose and dates?
Alex Gu: Yes. I'll draft the letter with company letterhead: visit dates 02/16-02/17, office address 120 Redwood Ave, and contact Alex Gu + Maya. Will include HR contact email.
Facilities: Hotel: per policy we can reserve a single night. Which hotel class? We usually book standard business (Hotel Grove). Want me to reserve 1 night 02/16-02/17? Shuttle?
Maya Singh (Recruiter): Please reserve Hotel Grove (standard) and request late check-in. Also arrange a shuttle voucher if available. Maria prefers ground-floor room due to ankle sprain.
Facilities: Noted ground-floor. Shuttle voucher will be added. I'll book and share confirmation number here.
Jonah (IT): eSIM voucher ready. I'll create a one-time QR and DM Maria. Also will tag headset H-55 and leave at front desk. Need locker code?
Front Desk: We'll hold envelope for "Mareda Elena Alvarez" with headset + printed invitation letter + SIM instructions. ID check required. Who will meet at 22:30 when she arrives?
Maya Singh (Recruiter): I'll meet her at 22:30 at arrivals. If my flight delays, Alex please pick up.
Alex Gu: Happy to do pickup if needed.
PeopleOps Bot: Checklist created: invitation_letter, hotel_booking, eSIM, headset, kosher_meal, quiet_room, shuttle_voucher. Flight monitor enabled (IB-773). Will post arrival updates. :white_check_mark:
Facilities: Hotel booked: Hotel Grove, confirmation HG-90214 (02/16-02/17). Ground-floor room requested; note in booking. Shuttle voucher attached to booking.
Maya Singh (Recruiter): Kosher lunch: order for 12:30 with sealed meals (candidate + 4). Also mark a vegetarian alternative. Delivery to lounge 12:20.
Jonah (IT): Headset (H-55) tagged and placed in envelope. eSIM QR created and DM'd to Maria. For the quiet 14:00 call, I'll reserve Quiet Room G from 13:50-14:30 and add Zoom standby with headset audio.
Maria Alvarez: Thank you everyone 60a. Got the eSIM QR and hotel confirmation. The visa appointment is 02/10; Alex if you can sign the letter today that would be amazing.
Alex Gu: Drafted and signed letter (PDF attached to Maya DM). Maya, please forward to Maria and confirm receipt.
Maya Singh (Recruiter): Sent signed PDF to Maria and cc'd HR inbox. Maria confirmed receipt.
Front Desk: Envelope will be printed with name (accent included) and held in drawer "Visitor Pack". Locker not needed. We'll verify passport at pickup.
PeopleOps Bot: Calendar update: ICS with Quiet Room G and Zoom fallback sent to Maria and interviewers: https://calendar.company/ical/2123456789.
Facilities: Parking: visitor permit P3-04 reserved 02/17 07:00-18:00 if she rents a car. If using shuttle, no permit needed.
Maya Singh (Recruiter): One policy question: Maria asked about reimbursement of visa interview fee if not selected. Is that covered?
Alex Gu: Per hiring ops policy, visa appointment fees are reimbursed only with hiring manager approval and receipts; not standard. I'll discuss with hiring committee post-loop if needed.
Maria Alvarez: Understood. Thanks for the clarity. Looking forward to the visit.
PeopleOps Bot: Flight IB-773 status: scheduled. Will post gate updates and delays to this thread.
